title: Patch: the fuzz monitor holds each Fatigue event to the seat's count and damage
thread:
**Issue #1902 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1902: Patch: the fuzz monitor holds each Fatigue event to the seat's count and damage
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a player draws from an empty library, the game reports a Fatigue event saying which hit it was and how much damage it dealt. The fuzz gate that plays random games all night never checks those numbers today, so an off-by-one in the count or the damage ladder would pass silently and surface only as wrong numbers on players' screens. After this, the monitor keeps a running count per seat and fails any seed whose Fatigue event skips a count, reports the wrong damage, or where the seat's fatigue count moves without an event.

## Why

`draw.rs:856-874` unconditionally bumps `fatigue_count` and emits `Fatigue { player, count, amount }` with `FATIGUE_DAMAGE(count)` (config.rs:164-171); §2.4 promises the increasing ladder and R3/R315 pin the counting. Yet `invariants.rs` contains zero mentions of fatigue — the `announced_state` pass tracks mana/turn/control/position/resets but has no Fatigue arm, so a wrong `count` or `amount` is invisible to every check.

## Proposal

A small shadow (`HashMap<PlayerId, i32>`, cleared on Glitch reset like the monitor's other shadows) checked in `after`: each `Fatigue` event carries the seat's Nth count in draw order and `amount == FATIGUE_DAMAGE(count)`; the action's last `Fatigue` per seat names `state.fatigue_count`; `fatigue_count` only moves alongside a `Fatigue` event.

## Where it lands

`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` (beside the I9 announced-state pass); spec §2.4, R3, R315; tests in the `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs` crafted-stream style.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Crafted streams — skipped count, wrong amount, `fatigue_count` moved silently — each fail with a named violation.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz` stays green on real games.

## Size and risks

Small, difficulty medium: one monitor arm plus tests; the check then runs every fuzz step for free. Risk: the Glitch-reset exemption must clear the shadow or late-game fatigues false-positive.
```
